requirements.title: Complete release scope and source preservation
requirements.rule: Preserve every accepted feature,122categories/recipes,42formulas and11full-source identities, and distinguish pending original empirical populations from implemented local product behavior.

requirements.title: Controlled acoustic clocks and repeated scopes
requirements.rule: Manipulate only selected lexical/phone scopes, preserve internal silence and both splice sources, retain exact piecewise clocks and every repeated unit interval, and use the declared native Praat parameters.

requirements.title: Optional independent audio diagnostics
requirements.rule: Run explicitly selected native, unconditioned ASR or actual auditory diagnostics against saved audio, retain actual model/context/receipts and failed history, replay without inference, and freeze same-case reports for optional review without changing primary scores.

requirements.title: All main frontend paths and actual media evidence
requirements.rule: Observe all11main routes through real Chrome, Next, API, PostgreSQL and private media with independently expected success/failure/recovery assertions, full-page pictures, flushed videos and the exact played audio.

requirements.title: Genuine local LLM exercise and review cycle
requirements.rule: Generate requested clean text and separate mutations/key, synthesize actual stored audio, save an answer, interpret it with the installed local LLM and calculate native scores/recommendations; optional review/dispute retains original versions and real context/Lab evidence without billed fallback.

requirements.title: Source-only Docker distribution
requirements.rule: Download/run source without Git or workflow metadata, using Docker as the only host runtime prerequisite, retain Apache2/third-party terms and provide actionable missing dependency errors.

requirements.title: Actual architecture and recovery acceptance
requirements.rule: Build and run the real service stack on arm64 and amd64, reject a wrong expected architecture, and observe stored database/media persistence and complete private backup/fresh restore.

requirements.title: Native and media evidence correspondence
requirements.rule: Retain actual pictures, flushed video, played audio and native/provider/Lab readback with explicit constructed/actual/unavailable boundaries; saved readback and maintenance perform no inference.

billing: Paid and hosted inference prohibited; installed local models only.
